title: Escalation Routing Rule R-002: Medication dosage asked
content:
ROUTING RULE: R-002 -- Medication dosage asked
TRIGGER TYPE: Intent
CONDITION: Dosage calculation inquiry
ROUTE TO: Clinical Review (Extension 1012)
QUEUE: QUEUE_CLINICAL
PRIORITY: URGENT
SLA: 1.0 hour(s)
ESCALATION RATIONALE: Severe risk of drug toxicity if answered by non-clinician. Dosing must be verified by licensed pharmacist or physician.
EXAMPLE QUERY 1: What is the pediatric dose of amikacin?
EXAMPLE QUERY 2: How many units of insulin should I give?
source_citation: SMCH Escalation Routing Matrix -- R-002 (Medication dosage asked) v1.0
